A-8983

SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-G in
the area bounded by:

a line 75 feet north of and parallel to West Balmoral Avenue; North Broadway; a line 50
feet north of and parallel to West Balmoral Avenue; and the alley next west of and
parallel to North Broadway,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

ni Manaa-Hoppenworth
‘Algérwoman, 48" Ward

Common Addresses:
5406 N. Broadway

ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-G in
the area bounded by:

      a line 75 feet north of and parallel to West Balmoral Avenue; North Broadway Avenue; a
      line 50 north of and parallel to West Balmoral Avenue; and the alley next west of and
      parallel to North Broadway Avenue,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        ____________________________
                                                        Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                        Alderwoman, 48th Ward
